blocks.translation:
● This product is intended for ages 15 and up. Never give it to children below the target age. ● This product contains small parts and batteries; ensure that small children do not accidentally swallow them, as this poses a risk of choking or other hazards. Do not use near the ears; improper use may damage hearing. ● This product contains electronic components and emits radio waves; individuals using pacemakers should exercise caution. ● Do not insert fingers or other objects into moving parts, as there is a risk of injury from pinching. ● Do not stare continuously at the flashing LED lights, as this may cause discomfort or nausea. 《Improper use of batteries may result in overheating, rupture, or leakage. Please observe the following:》 ● If a battery is swallowed or fluid leaking from a battery enters the eyes, consult a doctor immediately. If leaked fluid comes into contact with skin or clothing, wash it off with water. ● Swallowing batteries is dangerous; keep them out of the reach of children. Never use rechargeable batteries. Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries. ● Ensure the positive (+) and negative (-) terminals are aligned correctly. ● Always turn off the switch and remove the batteries after playing. Leaving batteries inside poses a risk of leakage. Do not short-circuit, recharge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into a fire. When disposing of the product...
 Please follow your local municipality's instructions for waste disposal.

す。誤動作した場合は電源を入れ直してください。●赤外線センサー反応部分の所にシールなどを貼らないでください。 動作しなくなります。 ●赤外線センサー反応

blocks.translation: <Precautions for Use> ● This product is a precision device. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause damage. It contains delicate electronic components; do not drop, wet, soil, or disassemble it. Avoid using or storing the product in areas subject to high or low temperatures. Do not place the product on resin sofas, seats, or tiles, as prolonged contact may cause color transfer. ● Do not forcefully pull or bend movable parts or attachment points in unnatural directions. Please note that due to the product's characteristics, some pronunciations may have unusual intonation or be difficult to hear. ● Please note that there may be variations in appearance due to the nature of the product. ● The product may malfunction if exposed to signals from other infrared remote controls, such as those for televisions. Malfunctions may also occur in locations exposed to direct sunlight (e.g., near windows) or directly under fluorescent lights. If a malfunction occurs, please turn the power off and on again. ● Do not place stickers or other objects over the infrared sensor area, as this will prevent the product from functioning. ● The product will not operate if there is an obstruction between the infrared sensor and your hand.

blocks.translation: Kotaro Minami's line "Transform!" will play, the movable parts will automatically transform, and the unit will start up in "Dialogue Mode." In Dialogue Mode, Kotaro Minami's lines are added to the transformation pose sounds and the various attack sounds.

blocks.text: 「台詞ボタン」を短押しします。 下記表の台詞が順番に鳴ります。
blocks.translation: Press the "Dialogue Button" briefly. The lines in the table below will play in order.

blocks.text: 創世王の奪い合いがしたいなら、俺もそうする。
blocks.translation: If you want to fight over the Creation King, I'll do the same.

blocks.text: 気が済んだか。 帰るぞ。
50年前とは違う。•••今日こそ、俺が終わらせる・・・!
blocks.translation: It's different from fifty years ago... Today, I'm the one who will put an end to this...!

blocks.text: 力じゃ勝てない。 まずは俺の指を剥がして折れ。 次に足の甲を踵で踏みつけろ。
blocks.translation: You can't win through brute force. First, pry my fingers loose and break them. Next, stomp on the instep of my foot with your heel.

blocks.text: 反転して手を外せ。 手が残ってたら引き込んで相手を崩せ。 踏み込んで肘で突け。
blocks.translation: Pivot and free your hand. If their hand remains, pull them in to break their balance. Step in and strike with your elbow.

blocks.text: お前は、怪人だけの世界を望むんだな。
blocks.translation: You desire a world inhabited solely by monsters, don't you?

blocks.text: クジラ、お前も俺の敵か?
blocks.translation: Whale, are you my enemy too?

blocks.text: 断る。 お前に、 キングストーンは渡さない。
blocks.translation: I refuse. I won't hand the King Stone over to you.

blocks.text: お前は怪人になって幸せだったか? 俺は、そう思ったことは一度も無い。
blocks.translation: Were you happy becoming a monster? I, for one, have never felt that way.

blocks.text: 新しい創世王が生まれても、 同じことを繰り返すだけだ。
blocks.translation: Even if a new Creation King is born, the same cycle will simply repeat.

blocks.text: 信彦が創世王になるなら止める。
blocks.translation: If Nobuhiko becomes the Creation King, I will stop him.

blocks.text: 怪人がこの世界からいなくなる。 それで十分だろ。
blocks.translation: Monsters will be gone from this world. That should be enough, right?

blocks.text: 俺も、受け継いでるんだよ。 50年前の俺が、 ずっと見張ってる。
blocks.translation: I've inherited it too. My fifty-years-ago self has been watching over me all along.

blocks.text: お前だって何もしなかったろ。 なんでゆかりを、 ビルゲニアから守れなかった!
blocks.translation: You didn't do anything either, did you? Why couldn't you protect Yukari from Bilgenia?!

blocks.text: あの時はここで止められたよな!
blocks.translation: We got stopped right here back then, didn't we?

blocks.text: 敗北の、 意味だ。 俺がダメだったら、次を、頼む。
blocks.translation: It signifies defeat. If I fail, I leave it to the next person.

blocks.text: あのキングストーンは、あいつの物だ。 俺らが奪っていいもんじゃない。
blocks.translation: That King Stone belongs to him. It's not something we should be taking.

blocks.text: そんなところに座って、 創世王にでもなるつもりか。
blocks.translation: Sitting there like that—do you intend to become the Creation King or something?

blocks.text: 乗れ。 葵、一緒にいる間だけは、俺が守ってやる。 ・・・帰るぞ。 乗れ。
blocks.translation: Get on. Aoi—as long as we're together, I'll protect you. ...Let's go home. Get on.
It can't be... Is it Aoi...?

blocks.text: それは、違う。 親父たちは、 俺たちに、争わせようとしたんじゃない。
blocks.translation: That's not it. Our fathers didn't intend for us to fight each other.

blocks.text: 信彦、そいつは俺がやる。 いいからどけ!
blocks.translation: Nobuhiko, I'll handle him. Just get out of the way!

blocks.text: 争わない、俺たちだから、選んだ。 ・・・そう思ったら、ダメか?
blocks.translation: We chose this because we don't fight. ...Is that the wrong way to think?

blocks.text: よくも葵を、 怪人に･･･。 許さん!
blocks.translation: How dare you turn Aoi into a monster... I won't forgive you!

blocks.text: 俺はお前から奪う物なんて何もない。 だから俺に託せ。
blocks.translation: There is nothing I want to take from you. So, entrust it to me.

blocks.text: 怪人は、人間だ。 誰かと出会って恋をする。 子供だって作る。
blocks.translation: Monsters are human. They meet people and fall in love. They even have children.

blocks.text: 生きて戦え。 戦い方を教えたはずだ。
blocks.translation: Stay alive and fight. I taught you how to fight, after all.

blocks.text: それで生きて、いつか死ぬ。 何も特別なことは無い。
blocks.translation: You live like that, and someday you die. There is nothing special about it.

blocks.text: 必ず帰る。 あの村で待ってろ。
blocks.translation: I'll definitely return. Wait for me in that village.

blocks.text: ゆかりが望んだ世界に、嘘は無いと、俺は思ってる。
blocks.translation: I believe there are no lies in the world Yukari wished for.

blocks.text: 怪人の命は、人間と何も変わらないと、俺はあんたに教わった。 それは今でも、変わらないのか。
blocks.translation: You taught me that a monster's life is no different from a human's. Does that still hold true?

blocks.text: 信彦! ... 信彦・・・おい! 信彦!
※「台詞モード」の場合、3で「変･･･」、5 で「身!」の台詞が一緒に鳴ります。 ※ベルトの発光は、 変身後に1分間継続します。
blocks.translation: * In "Dialogue Mode," at 3 the line "Hen..." and at 5 the line "...shin!" will play together. * The belt's illumination remains on for 1 minute after transformation.

blocks.text:
自動変形の途中に動きを妨げると、 安全性の確保のため、 自動変形が停止します。
その場合、一度変身解除をするか電源を入れ直して、変身前の開いた状態に戻してください。
●メーターの針の停止位置は多少のばらつき・ブレがございます。
■可動部分のスピードやメーターの針の動きは、電池の消費状況によって変わりますのでご注意ください。
●赤外線センサーは、太陽光の下や、太陽光が入り込む屋内ではうまく反応しません。
太陽光の当たらない屋内でお遊びください。
●赤外線センサーの反応距離は、可動部 (左上・右上)のパーツに手が乗るくらいの距離になります。
反応が悪いときは、手をさらに赤外線センサーに近づけてください。
blocks.translation:
If movement is obstructed during automatic transformation, the automatic transformation will stop to ensure safety.
In that case, either cancel the transformation once or turn the power off and back on to return it to the open (pre-transformation) state.
● The meter needle's stop position may vary slightly.
■ The speed of movable parts and the movement of the meter needle may change depending on battery condition, so please be careful.
● The infrared sensors do not respond well under direct sunlight or in indoor areas where sunlight enters. Play indoors away from direct sunlight.
● The infrared sensor's response distance is about the distance from which a hand would rest on the movable parts (upper left / upper right). If response is poor, move your hand closer to the infrared sensor.

If you continue holding them after the two "Select sounds" finish, about 3 seconds later the "change into the Creation King" sound will play, the belt will light up, and it will enter the <Creation King State>.

blocks.text: <創世王 状態> 台詞再生遊び
<創世王状態>で「台詞ボタン」を押します。 下記の音声が順番に鳴ります。
blocks.translation: Press the "Dialogue Button" while in <Creation King State>. The following audio lines will play in order.

blocks.text: 力じゃ勝てない。 まずは俺の指を剥がして折れ。 次に足の甲を踵で踏みつけろ。 反転して手を外せ。 手が残ってたら引き込んで相手を崩せ。 踏み込んで肘で突け。
blocks.translation: You can't win by strength. First, pry my fingers off and break them. Next, stomp the instep with your heel. Twist and release the hand. If the hand remains, pull it in to unbalance the opponent. Step in and strike with your elbow.

blocks.text: <創世王状態>で 「変身・攻撃ボタン」を押します。 「創世王のエキスを垂れ流す音」が鳴ります。
blocks.translation: In <Creation King State>, press the "Transform/Attack Button." A sound of the Creation King's essence dripping will play.

blocks.text: <変身後状態>で「変身・攻撃ボタン」と「台詞ボタン」を同時に短押しします。「変身解除音」が鳴り、ベルトが自動変形して開き、 <変身前状態>に戻ります。
blocks.translation: While in the <Post-Transformation State>, briefly press the "Transform/Attack Button" and the "Dialogue Button" simultaneously. The "De-transformation sound" will play, the belt will automatically transform and open, and it will return to the <Pre-Transformation State>.

blocks.text: <創世王状態>で「変身・攻撃ボタン」と「台詞ボタン」を同時に押します。「創世王消滅音」 が鳴り、 <変身前状態に戻ります。
blocks.translation: In <Creation King State>, press the "Transform/Attack Button" and the "Dialogue Button" simultaneously. The "Creation King disappearance sound" will play, and it will return to the <Pre-Transformation State>.
